enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element Hive Larvae, plus one per overworld movement round since spawning, across the rightmost three columns (space permitting), spread over all six lanes. Larvae have 16 HP, move west without attacking, then hit for 18 damage and disappear on their next command at the left edge. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs remove the whole Construct without damage: recallable cards to Discard, non-recallable cards and their attachments to Destroyed. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both then attack for 1 damage of their element, even if blocked from moving; at the left edge they instead attack for 12 or 9 respectively and disappear. All moving insects swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy hits Ideons below it in the same column; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale for other positions.
